As part of the Social Ecology instructional design team, the Instructional Designer 2 (ID 2) will support self-supported degree programs (SSDP), including our newest SSDP, launching Fall 2026, and state-supported undergraduate courses. The ID 2 will work collaboratively with the instructional design team to prepare and maintain courses, support faculty throughout course delivery, troubleshoot and support learning technologies, and contribute to team instructional design projects and initiatives.

The ID 2 will use instructional design, educational technology, and multimedia development skills to help maintain, develop, troubleshoot, and shape curricular materials into consistent and engaging learning experiences grounded in sound pedagogy and best practice. They will leverage technology with intention to craft learning experiences that are clear, easy to navigate, and foster active engagement and meaningful learning. A key part of this work includes conducting quality assurance reviews to ensure course materials and environments meet established standards prior to launch, including verifying ADA compliance, copyright adherence, and other institutional obligations.

The ID 2 will serve as a learning technologies resource for the team, staying current with emerging tools and trends in instructional design and educational technology. The ID 2 will provide day-to-day technical support to ensure the smooth operation of course environments and team workflows.

Additionally, the ID 2 will work on instructional design content and initiatives that are of moderate scope and complexity, demonstrating a high degree of collaboration and diplomacy as well as problem analysis and creative solutions, and solve complex content or delivery related issues in collaboration with technical teams. The incumbent will interact with senior internal and external personnel and exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate actions.
